descriptionByLocale.en:
The specialist centre of Glatt is a modern, multidisciplinary practice operated by the Cantonal Hospital of Winterthur. To complement our sympathetic team we are looking for a Med as of September 1, 2026 or by agreement. Practical assistant / practical assistant or specialist health. A varied field of activity awaits you with plenty of space for development and initiative. Our practice is open Monday to Friday, we do not provide emergency services and offer five weeks of vacation. The place of work is located in the Glatt shopping center, which also makes you profit from attractive employee benefits, such as discounts in numerous shops and a free parking lot. Tasks:
• You conduct the intercourse assistant for various disciplines such as hand surgery, gynecology, angiology, domestic medical, plastic surgery, visceral surgery, neurosurgery and vascular surgery
• You have the opportunity to assist in surgical operations in local anaesthesia or general anaesthesia
• You carry out blood collections, perform laboratory analyses and ensure efficient and structured speech-time planning
• At the reception you greet patients and provide competent telephone information
• You are responsible for inventory management, guide the practice apotheke and order medical material as well as instruments
• Depending on your strengths and interests, you will perform advanced tasks – such as coordination of specific areas of work or cooperation in projects Profile:
• You have successfully completed your training as a medical practice assistant/medical practice assistant or specialist health, ideally you have several years of practical experience and have good IT skills (MS Office)
• You are a motivated, flexible and socially-competent personality with high service orientation and very good ways of handling
• You communicate clearly, you like to work in an interdisciplinary manner and bring team spirit and sense of responsibility
• You want to move more, introduce yourself, take responsibility and actively shape our practice environment Benefits: The KSW provides employees with conditions that enable them to meet their professional goals and personal needs. Flexible, sliding working hours, home office as well as a generous maternity leave and levels of employment adapted to different situations of life – this is all possible at the KSW if it permits the operation; Every year, the KSW offers 40 overtime and 50 professional training courses. We also support you in external developments in time and/or financial terms; In exceptional situations, e.g. longer illness, strong personal burden or difficult experiences in the private and in the everyday professional life, you have various conversation offers available. The valuable and friendly cooperation within the teams and across the departments is characterized by the working climate at the KSW. As a sign for a strong team idea, the "Du" was introduced as a standard at the KSW. In addition, the KSW supports annual team events financially and organizes a large staff festival for the whole house every four years; KSW employees benefit from very good social benefits. Thus, the pension funds solution with the BVK is far above the statutory minimum. Even in the event of illness or accident, KSW employees are very well secured; With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training options and course offers, discounts in pharmacies and among the most popular health insurance companies.
